[{"proname":"atlas_user_can_access_warehouse","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.atlas_user_can_access_warehouse(p_warehouse_id uuid)\n RETURNS boolean\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select exists(select 1 from public.profile_warehouse_access a join auth.users u on u.id=a.user_id\n    join public.warehouses w on w.id=a.warehouse_id and w.active\n    where a.user_id=auth.uid() and a.warehouse_id=p_warehouse_id and u.deleted_at is null\n      and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=now()));\n$function$\n"},{"proname":"is_supervisor","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_supervisor()\n RETURNS boolean\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select exists(select 1 from public.profiles p join auth.users u on u.id=p.user_id\n    where p.user_id=auth.uid() and p.role in ('supervisor','admin')\n      and u.deleted_at is null and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=now()));\n$function$\n"}]
